document.title: Gilgamesh dreams of Enkidu: An Old Babylonian tablet of Gilgamesh in the Suleimaniyah Museum
Gilgamesh dreams of Enkidu: An Old Babylonian tablet of Gilgamesh in the Suleimaniyah Museum
Gilgamesh dreams of Enkidu: An Old Babylonian tablet of Gilgamesh in the Suleimaniyah Museum

lines.translation: #tr.en: “O [Enkidu, even before you came from your uplands,]

manuscripts.atf: u[l-li-iš {d}GIŠ.GILₓ(BIL₂)-ga-mes i-na ŠA₃ UNUG{ki} i-da-ga-al šu-na-tim]

lines.translation: #tr.en: yonder [in Uruk Gilgamesh was dreaming (of you).]
#tr.en: [Gilgamesh] lay(!) [down and had a dream,]
#tr.en: he arose to [talk to his mother:]
#tr.en: ‘[The stars of the sky] parted company,
#tr.en: a lump of sky-rock [fell down before me.]
#tr.en: I tested its (weight) but [it was too heavy for me,]
#tr.en: I gave it a shove but [could not move it.]
#tr.en: Numerous Uruk was gathered [about me (@i{or} it),]

variants.reconstruction:
%n pahrū | eṭlūtum || ul il[eʾʾū | šuqqâšu]
// L I.4 MB "Priv₁" 13

lines.translation: #tr.en: the young men all together could not [raise it.]
#tr.en: I braced my forehead, they [supported me,]
#tr.en: I picked it up and took it away [into your presence.]’

manuscripts.atf: um#-mi {d}GIŠ.GILₓ(BIL₂)-ga-mes mu-[de-a-at x x x x]

lines.translation: #tr.en: The mother of Gilgamesh, being [wise, explained (@i{or} wise in all things),]
#tr.en: saying to [Gilgamesh:]

manuscripts.atf: ma# mi-in-de {d}GIŠ.GILₓ(BIL₂)-ga-mes ša# [x x x x x]

lines.translation: #tr.en: so: ‘For sure, Gilgamesh, there is one [like yourself,]
#tr.en: he was born in the land and [the wild (@i{or} uplands)] reared [him.]

variants.reconstruction:
%n kīma kiṣrim | ša ānim || dunnun[ā | emūqāšu]
// L I.4 MB "Priv₁" 20

manuscripts.atf: ki-ma ki-iṣ-ri-im ša an-ni du-un-nu-n[a x x x x]

lines.translation: #tr.en: [His strength is] as mighty as a lump of sky-rock,
#tr.en: so that I shall make him [your] equal.

variants.reconstruction:
%n ul īdûšū-ma | ipahhurū | [elīšu]
// L I.4 MB "Priv₁" 22

lines.translation: #tr.en: Not knowing who he is, they will gather [around him,]
#tr.en: him the young men will kiss.
#tr.en: You will see him and your heart will rejoice,

manuscripts.atf: [te-ed]-di#-ra-aš-šu-u₂-ma ta-ra-ad-di-[šu x x x x x]

lines.translation: #tr.en: [you will] hug him and lead [him into my presence.]’
#tr.en: Gilgamesh [lay down] and had [a dream (@i{or} another),]
#tr.en: [he arose to talk] to [his] mother.”
